proposition.location:
Retained report, Problem 1: Problem 1 (Major: Corollary 3.13(26)). The sufficient row count on p. 19 is false uniformly over the sub-Gaussian ensembles permitted by Definition 3.6, p. 15.

Retained report, Problem 2: Problem 2 (Minor: squared normalized-slice equations). In Lemma 2.15(c), pp. 10–11, the polynomial equations describe a larger set than the asserted preimage of an affine slice.

Retained report, Problem 3: Problem 3 (Minor: arbitrary open dense rational domains). Lemma 2.17, p. 11 and p. 32, is false for all domains allowed by Definition 3.15, p. 21.

Retained report, Problem 4: Problem 4 (Minor: zero inequality constraints). The minimum in Lemma 2.18, pp. 11 and 32–33, contains \((cb^2)^N\), although \(b=0\) is explicitly used for varieties.

Retained report, Problem 5: Problem 5 (Minor: radius range in Corollary 2.19). The tube-volume bound on p. 11 omits the range \(0<\varepsilon\le\operatorname{diam}V\) needed for the invoked covering estimate.

Retained report, Problem 6: Problem 6 (Minor: a vanishing logarithmic complexity term). There is a separate low-dimensional endpoint failure in Corollary 3.13(26), p. 19.

Retained report, Problem 7: Problem 7 (Minor: reversed factors in Remark 3.9). The displayed approximate-minimizer chain on p. 17 uses the distortion factors in the wrong direction.

Retained report, Problem 8: Problem 8 (Minor: the left side of Theorem 3.18). Equations (34)–(35) and the intermediate proof display on p. 22 write \(\mathcal N\) where \(\log\mathcal N\) is required.

Retained report inspection subject: Orthonormal basis qualification in Lemma3.3
